rules.duplicates: Remove exact duplicates across the eight original columns; retain the first source row. This is an explicit assumption: repeated identical lines cannot be verified as accidental from this source.
rules.merchandise: StockCode must be five digits followed by zero or more letters. Non-catalogue charges, manual codes and gift vouchers are excluded from merchandise sales and returns.
rules.sales: Positive quantity and positive unit price; valid invoice/date/country; invoice must not start with C.
rules.returns: Negative quantity and positive unit price for the same merchandise scope. Record absolute value on the return invoice date; never match to an assumed original order.
rules.identity: Anonymous sales remain in commercial totals, but cannot enter customer models or retention cohorts.
rules.revenue: Gross merchandise sales less recorded merchandise returns is net merchandise revenue, not accounting revenue or profit. No costs or marketing spend are provided.
rules.period: The final observed month (December 2011) is incomplete. Main commercial metrics and cohort maturity stop before 2011-12-01.
